title: Chemical short-range order increases the phonon heat conductivity in a refractory high-entropy alloy

recollection.intervention: guess: varying chemical composition or processing conditions to alter short-range order
recollection.structure: guess: crystalline solid solution with varying degrees of short-range order
recollection.mechanism: guess: altered phonon scattering and transport due to changes in short-range order

score.note: The recollection is generic and largely restates the title. It mentions altering short-range order and phonon scattering but misses Monte Carlo-induced HfTi/TiZr clustering, B2-like ordering, percolation pathways, reduced lattice distortion, and high-frequency phonon-DOS changes. It recalls the direction of the result but not the approximately 12% increase.
